knowledge_used.how_applied: Decisive for Option C: a separate driver card is justified only if it mates directly at the gate/Kelvin pins; with two TO-247-4 it adds connector inductance to the gate loop for no reuse benefit, so C is rejected. In Option B the drivers stay on the power board within 15 mm of the device leads (target metric).

Floor plan places the HF ceramic column and the L1/L2 Vin+/PGND pair (0.20 mm prepreg) for the commutation loop before the driver islands; connector inductance is kept outside both loops by passing only logic-level signals over the mezzanine.

Power-board stack-up: gate pours on L4 with the drivers, Kelvin-source pours on L3 across a 0.20 mm prepreg, Kelvin layer between the gate layer and all other copper; this is the main argument for 4 rather than 2 layers.
Partition keeps the Kelvin-source net inside the driver island (L3 pour) and never merges it with the power-source pour on L1/L2; carried into the pcb_constraints for the TO-247-4 footprint.
Parallel Vin+/SW/Vout+ pours on L1 and L3 and PGND on L2/L4 with via arrays; the rule's low confidence is noted, the sizing itself comes from the capacitor, inductor and standards agents (IPC-2221).

10 mm copper-free ISO_BARRIER on all four power-board layers along the whole 240 mm length; the stacked control board must not carry copper above HV copper; Option C would create a second barrier instance per driver card (counted against C).

Distances are not derived here; the standards agent's 9.0 mm / 5.5 mm / 5.0 mm / 3.0 mm values are applied as geometry, and the air-gap argument for the stacked control board (12.1 mm worst case) is surfaced for insulation-coordination review.
Power board carries the ten standards-agent classes; the control board carries CTRL_SELV only, which is one of the reasons its DRC is trivial in Option B.
All seven barrier parts (2 x UCC21710, 2 x UCC14141, 2 x AMC1311, TMCS1133) sit on one barrier line with 1.0 mm non-plated slots under every body whose land gap is below 9 mm.
One PE-bonded heat sink for both TO-247-4 with rated insulating pads; a 5 mm HV-copper keep-out around the sink footprint is included in the heat-sink reservation (110 x 50 mm).
Used only as a sanity check of the heat-sink envelope: T_J = 105 / 122 / 139 degC for R_th,HS = 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.1 K/W at 56.2 W; the thermal agent owns the selection.

The mezzanine (11 mm stack + <= 80 mm strip trace) is treated as the rule's short on-board exclusion: buffered single-ended PWM with RC at the driver pins (controller agent); RS-422 (CB-GD-003) becomes mandatory if a cable > ~150 mm is ever used.
Differential interface not needed for the stacked mezzanine; recorded as the fallback for a cabled variant.

The 12 V entry and TPS26400 eFuse (CB-PR-001) are placed on the control board at the connector, so the power board receives only protected 12 V over three mezzanine pins; relay-coil current conflict surfaced.

Principles 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 drive the stack-up, barrier line, net classes, slots and signal concept; the scope note (PRD-09301: separate driver boards typical for ~200 kW+) rejects Option C; procedure steps 1-2 are turned into the layer assignment table.

Principle 4 (thermal placement must not lengthen electrical loops) puts the drivers on the bottom side under the device row while the devices stand on the sink; step 3 (films and magnetics out of the exhaust) is applied as the fan/exhaust-zone rule but flagged as a recommendation without source evidence; heat-sink envelope sized at about 900 cm2 fin area.

Principle 1 (SELV control domain, every crossing a rated isolator) defines the barrier line and the SELV strip; the interface items of principle 9 are taken from the controller agent rather than re-derived.
Bias modules straddle the barrier with slots; their input CM chokes and capacitors are placed on the SELV strip side (KR-IS-002); module selection belongs to the bias agent.
Only the placement outputs of the capacitor agent (HF column within 5-15 mm of the pins, films within 30-40 mm, >= 20 mm pours on two layers) are used to size the HV area.
Sensing isolators are placed on the barrier line; the Hall sensor sits in the output path at the barrier so that no SELV corridor crosses the HV area.

Decision 10 (power board + control card, drivers on the bottom beside each TO-247-4, LV circuitry along the edge, 300 x 180 mm 4 layers) is the pattern for Option B and the size benchmark; decision 9 (vertical sinks, two devices each) sets the heat-sink concept; TI's instance values are not copied.

Decision 6 island sizes (25.4 x 30.5 mm per channel on a 50.8 x 61 mm board) calibrate the 30 x 35 mm driver-island envelope; decision 4 confirms single-ended links are acceptable on-board; PRD-09301 scope note supports rejecting Option C.

Decision 7 (47.6 x 17.8 mm 4-layer 1 oz driver card with 1 mm slots) gives the Option C driver-card envelope (50 x 30 mm, 4 layers 35 um) used in the area and cost model; its 8 mm creepage is not generalised.

PE-PCB-007 (control separated from power structures) is implemented by the two-board partition; PE-PCB-002/003 by the HF column and L1/L2 loop; PE-PCB-006 by the parallel pours; PE-PCB-008 by per-pin decoupling on both boards; evidence remains human review per docs/pcb-design-rules.md.

300 x 220 mm six-layer integrated board, control+aux bbox 128.5 x 93.7 mm at 15 % utilisation and known issue V1-09 (fine pitch on heavy copper) are the quantitative baseline that Option A would repeat and Option B avoids; V1's single-ground control practice is reused on the control board.

pcb_constraints: Power board: 4 layers, 70 um on every layer, 2.0 mm; L1/L2 separated by 0.20 mm prepreg for the commutation loop, L3/L4 by 0.20 mm prepreg for the gate loop; symmetric stack with a ~1.1 mm core (KR-PCB-001, KR-PCB-004, KR-PCB-006, PE-PCB-003).

ISO_BARRIER rule area 10 mm wide on all four power-board layers along the full 240 mm length between the HV/DRV/DESAT classes and CTRL_SELV; 9.0 mm class-pair clearance; 1.0 mm non-plated slots under UCC21710 x2, UCC14141 x2, AMC1311 x2 and TMCS1133 (KR-ISO-001, KR-ISO-002 review, KR-ISO-004).

All seven barrier parts on one straight barrier line; the device row immediately on the HV side of the driver islands; the SELV strip is the board edge; no SELV corridor may cross the HV area (KR-ISO-001, KR-PCB-005).

Drivers, DESAT, rail decoupling and bias modules on L4 directly under the device row within 15 mm of the TO-247-4 leads; gate pour on L4, Kelvin-source pour on L3, Kelvin-source net never merged with the power source (KR-PCB-001, KR-PCB-003, KR-PCB-005, SKILL-006 principle 4, PE-PCB-001).
Heat-sink footprint reservation 100 x 40 mm with a 5 mm HV-copper keep-out (PE class); both devices on rated insulating pads; sink height <= 55 mm (KR-TH-002, A-24).

Control board: 4 layers 35 um, solid GND_CTRL on L2, no plane splits under ADC or PWM tracks; copper never above HV copper of the power board; analogue connector pins at the far end from PWM pins (PE-PCB-007, PE-PCB-008, controller agent).

Mezzanine socket on the power-board SELV strip, header on the control board; four M3 standoffs to the baseplate; stack height per confirmed connector drawing; parts under the control board <= 8 mm tall.

Inductor keep-out circle 75 mm, >= 10 mm from the heat sink, in a parallel air path; films beside the sink, not in the exhaust; exhaust zone holds only terminals, bleeders and the PE stud (SKILL-006 step 3, flagged recommendation).

HV terminals, relay-contact terminals and PTC grouped at the input and output ends; PE stud M4 bonded to the heat sink and baseplate; HV copper >= 1.0 mm from the board edge, >= 5.0 mm where the earthed baseplate edge can touch.
Net classes per the standards agent on the power board; CTRL_SELV only on the control board (KR-ISO-003).
Target metrics after layout as listed in selection.target_metrics_after_layout; evidence per docs/pcb-design-rules.md remains human review.
open_issues: Relay-coil budget conflict: the sensing agent's Omron G9EA-1 coil draws 417 mA (fetched datasheet) while the controller agent budgeted 100 mA and sized the eFuse at 1.425 A minimum; the 12 V bus rises to about 1.13 A at 10.8 V (margin 1.26x). Resolve by PWM hold (sensing agent's suggestion), a lower-power relay with >= 16 A carry current, or a higher ILIM.

Heat-sink envelope: the 80 mm height limit (A-24) excludes 75 mm vertical profiles such as CR201-50VE; the thermal agent must select a <= 55 mm profile with R_th <= 0.6 K/W at 2 m/s (sanity check: T_J 122 degC at 0.8 K/W) or lay the extrusion on its side, which changes the footprint reservation.

Mezzanine stack height (11 mm design value) and the Wurth 50-pin socket orderability are unverified (Samtec PDF not text-readable, samtec.com HTTP 429, we-online 61305021821.pdf HTTP 404); standoff length follows the confirmed value.

Power board 2 versus 4 layers: the seed allows 2-4; this design recommends 4 (gate/Kelvin adjacency, thin commutation-loop dielectric, parallel pours, SELV-strip ground). A 2-layer build saves about 40 % of the power-board cost index and is acceptable only if the layout agent demonstrates the loop and adjacency targets in two layers.

Barrier area cost: the strict 9.0 mm all-layer rule plus the 10 mm keep-out consumes 2,400 mm2 (5.6 % of the power board); if the standards review accepts the 5.5 mm minimum, the SELV strip can shrink by 4 mm.

Stacked control board over the barrier zone relies on an air-clearance argument (>= 11 mm) between boards; the standards agent must confirm that clearance through air applies between two boards at pollution degree 2 and that control-board copper may be above the copper-free barrier zone.

HV terminal type (M5/M6 studs with ring lugs versus 2-pole screw terminal blocks), the fuse-holder and relay harness, and finger-safe covers (IPXXB) are not yet chosen; they affect the input/output end zones (1,600 mm2 reserved).

Airflow direction and the exhaust-zone rule follow SKILL-006 step 3, which the knowledge base flags as a recommendation without source evidence; the thermal agent should confirm with the fan curve and heat-sink impedance.
TO-247-4 package drawing was not text-readable (Wolfspeed Rev. 2 PDF); the footprint agent must take lead pitch and body dimensions from the datasheet drawing.
Area estimates carry about +/-15 % uncertainty; the stretch outline 230 x 170 mm should be attempted first in placement, and the 240 x 180 mm target is the acceptance limit.
Option C remains available if a future >= 50 kW variant uses modules; it must then follow KR-PCB-005 (cards mating at the gate pins) and carry its own barrier per card (KR-ISO-001).

Knowledge maintenance: SKILL-002 and SKILL-006 could record the partition pattern used here (barrier line through all isolators, device row adjacent to the barrier, SELV strip at the edge, control board stacked over SELV only) as a reusable placement pattern once the layout confirms it.
verification_status: Analytically checked: HV zone sum and HV area, control-board sizing, outlines and areas for A/B/C, height stack and A-24 check, volumes, cost index, fine-pitch etch budget, weighted scoring with three sensitivity sets, air gap for the stacked control board, barrier heat conduction, heat-sink sanity, mezzanine pin current, mass. Component inputs: Omron G9EA-1 dimensions and coil from the fetched datasheet; TDK film dimensions, UCC21710/UCC14141/AMC1311/TMCS1133 data from sibling agents' fetched datasheets; TI controlCARD practice from ti.com (manufacturer page); Samtec, Ohmite CR201 and TO-247-4 body dimensions at search-snippet level; mezzanine stack height, standoff hardware, utilisation factors, cost factors and masses unverified. # PCB architecture selection (Options A / B / C)

AI-GENERATED ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE V2 - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED. This section becomes `review/architecture_comparison.md` and `design/architecture.md`.

## 1 Scope and inputs

The task is to choose how the 400 V -> 200 V, 5 kW, 50 kHz SiC synchronous buck is partitioned into printed-circuit boards and to fix outlines, layer counts, copper weights, stack-ups, the part-to-board partition, the interconnect and the mechanical concept. Component envelopes come from the other design agents: two Wolfspeed C4MS025120K TO-247-4 on one insulated, PE-bonded heat sink (KR-TH-002); 2 x TDK B32776G8206K input films (28 x 42 mm footprint, 37 mm high) and 2 x B32776G4606K output films (30 x 42 mm, 45 mm); ten 2220 HF ceramics in a column at the device pins (KR-CAP-003, PE-PCB-002); a custom 2-stack High Flux toroid with a 75 mm keep-out circle and 48 mm height; the barrier parts TMCS1133, 2 x AMC1311, 2 x UCC21710-Q1 and 2 x UCC14141-Q1; the controller agent's 2 x 25-pin 2.54 mm mezzanine. The standards agent fixes the geometry of the SELV / HV barrier: 9.0 mm between any HV, DRV or DESAT class and CTRL_SELV on every layer, a 10 mm copper-free ISO_BARRIER rule area (KR-ISO-001, KR-ISO-002 human review), 5.0 mm from HV copper to the PE heat sink and 3.0 mm between HV functional groups (KR-ISO-003). The benchmark is V1: 300 x 220 mm, six layers, 70 um outer copper with an LQFP-176 (known issue V1-09), a control-plus-auxiliary section measuring 128.5 x 93.7 mm at 15 % footprint utilisation (measured from `design/placement.json`).

## 2 Options

| Option | Boards | Pattern in the knowledge base |
|---|---|---|
| A | one integrated power + control PCB, 70 um on every layer, 4 layers (6 if routing demands, as V1 needed) | V1 (project precedent) |
| B | power PCB (MOSFETs, drivers, bias, DC-link, inductor, output capacitors, sensing isolators, fast protection, thermal) + DSP control PCB (F28335, supplies, PWM/fault logic, ADC front ends, comms, JTAG, clock/reset), stacked mezzanine | REF-TI-TIDA-010054 decision 10 (power board + control card, LV circuitry along the edge) |
| C | as B plus one plug-in gate-driver card per switch mating at the device pins | REF-WS-CGD15SG00D2 decision 7 (47.6 x 17.8 mm, 4 layers), REF-WS-CGD1700HB2M-UNA (module driver board) |

## 3 Area and volume model

HV-side zones (footprint plus local keep-out) sum to 24,645 mm2: heat-sink reservation 100 x 40 mm plus the 5 mm PE keep-out (5,500), inductor 75 x 75 plus a 10 mm band to the sink (6,375), output films (2,666), input films (2,494), terminals (1,600), relay/PTC interface (1,000), isolator zones with slots (1,500), driver islands on the bottom side (1,050, half counted because they sit under the sink footprint, SKILL-006 principle 4), HF tier (560) and small items (1,900). With the bus copper, the 3 mm HV functional spacing and the film-capacitor pours, the HV area is set to 240 x 140 mm (28,800 mm2, 86 % zone utilisation). The barrier adds 240 x 10 mm and the SELV strip 240 x 30 mm.

The control section footprints sum to 2,869 mm2 (LQFP-176 courtyard 751, 40 decoupling capacitors 172, supplies 625, logic and comparators 289, mezzanine 324, JTAG/UART/boot 274, remainder 234). At 30 % utilisation (V1 reached 15 %; TI controlCARDs are denser) a 120 x 80 mm, 4-layer, 35 um control board follows:

    A_ctrl = 2,869 mm2 / 0.30 = 9,563 mm2 -> 120 x 80 mm = 9,600 mm2

On a 70 um board (Option A) the same functions need coarser features (0.25 mm track/space, 0603 passives): 13,000 mm2 assumed, i.e. 54 mm of depth across 240 mm.

| Metric | A | B | C | V1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Outline(s), mm | 240 x 204 | power 240 x 180 + control 120 x 80 | power 240 x 170 + 2 driver cards 50 x 30 + control 120 x 80 | 300 x 220 |
| Total PCB area, mm2 | 48,960 | 52,800 | 53,400 | 66,000 |
| Occupied plan area, mm2 | 48,960 | 48,000 (control board overhangs 40 mm beyond the power-board edge) | 48,000 | 66,000 |
| Plan bounding box, mm | 240 x 204 | 240 x 220 | 240 x 220 | 300 x 220 |
| Height above baseplate, mm | 67 | 67 (control stack top 39) | 67 | not recorded |
| Volume, L (bounding / occupied) | 3.28 / 3.28 | 3.54 / 3.08 | 3.54 / 3.1 | - |

Height: 15 mm standoffs (A-24) + 2.0 mm board + 50 mm heat-sink reservation = 67 mm, inside the 80 mm limit; inductor top 65 mm, films 62 mm. A CR201-50VE-class vertical sink (75 mm tall, distributor data) would reach 92 mm and is therefore excluded from the envelope; the thermal agent must select a profile <= 55 mm tall or lay the extrusion on its side.

## 4 Cost and manufacturability

    cost index = sum over boards of area[dm2] x layer factor (2L 1.0, 4L 1.8, 6L 2.8) x copper factor (70 um 1.5, 35 um 1.0)

A: 13.2 (4 layers) or 20.6 (6 layers); B: 13.4 with a 4-layer 70 um power board, 8.2 with 2 layers, plus one connector pair; C: 13.3 / 8.4 plus three connector sets and three assemblies; V1 for reference about 24. The raw board cost of A and B is therefore equal at four layers. The decisive difference is DFM: the LQFP-176 at 0.5 mm pitch has a nominal pad gap of 0.22 mm; with +/-0.06 mm per side etch allowance on 70 um copper the effective gap is 0.10 mm against the 0.20 mm minimum space, so Option A needs a special fine-line heavy-copper process or mixed copper weights (exactly V1-09). On 35 um the effective gap is 0.16 mm >= 0.15 mm. Heat conduction across the copper-free barrier is negligible in every option (R_th = L/(k A) = 0.010 m / (0.3 W/mK x 0.24 m x 0.002 m) = 69 K/W), so the cooling difference between A and B is only exhaust air and radiation (SKILL-006 step 3, flagged recommendation).

## 5 Weighted scoring

Weights: manufacturing cost/DFM 0.20 (the V1 failure mode), EMI loop integrity 0.15 and barrier/grounding 0.15 (hard-switched 400 V SiC; KR-PCB-004, KR-ISO-001), testability 0.10 (nine-step commissioning A-37; double-pulse per KR-PR-001), total area 0.10, and 0.05 each for volume, cooling, connector reliability, modularity, layout complexity and future redesign (secondary for a 5 kW laboratory prototype).

| Criterion (weight) | A | B | C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturing cost and DFM (0.20) | 2 | 4 | 3 |
| EMI: commutation and gate loops, CM coupling (0.15) | 3 | 4 | 2 |
| Isolation barrier and grounding (0.15) | 3 | 4 | 3 |
| Ease of testing (0.10) | 2 | 4 | 4 |
| Total PCB area (0.10) | 4 | 4 | 3 |
| Assembly volume (0.05) | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Cooling interaction (0.05) | 3 | 4 | 3 |
| Connector reliability (0.05) | 5 | 4 | 2 |
| Modularity / reuse (0.05) | 1 | 4 | 5 |
| Layout complexity (0.05) | 2 | 4 | 3 |
| Future redesign (0.05) | 2 | 4 | 4 |
| Weighted total | 2.75 | 4.00 | 3.10 |

Sensitivity: area/volume-weighted 3.10 / 4.00 / 3.05; equal weights 2.82 / 4.00 / 3.27; modularity/test-weighted 2.45 / 4.00 / 3.45. Option B leads under every weighting tried.

## 6 Recommendation: Option B

Option B is selected. It removes the fine-pitch DSP from the heavy-copper board, gives the control board a continuous 35 um ground plane (PE-PCB-007/008, V1 single-ground practice), lets the power board be tested with a bench PWM source at the mezzanine (double-pulse, KR-PR-001) and the control board with a simulator, and keeps the drivers on the power board beside their switches (KR-PCB-005, SKILL-002 principle 4). Only logic-level SELV signals cross the connector, so connector inductance is outside both the gate loop and the commutation loop (KR-PCB-004). The mezzanine is a short on-board-class link (11 mm stack plus <= 80 mm of trace), which is the explicit exclusion of KR-GD-008: buffered single-ended PWM with 100 ohm / 100 pF filters at the driver pins is acceptable; RS-422 (CB-GD-003) is the mandatory fallback if a cable longer than about 150 mm is ever introduced.

Option C is rejected: a separate driver card is only justified if it mates directly at the gate / Kelvin-source pins (KR-PCB-005), and PRD-09301 places separate driver boards in the ~200 kW+ class (SKILL-002 scope note). For two TO-247-4 devices it adds two connectors in the gate loop, two assemblies and a second barrier instance (KR-ISO-001) for no reuse benefit. Option A is rejected because it repeats V1: the control section forces a fine-pitch process onto a 70 um board, the SELV plane must stop at the barrier on a board shared with the 400 V switch node, and any change respins the whole heavy-copper board.

## 7 Board definitions

| Board | Outline target (stretch) | Layers / copper | Thickness | Minimum features |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Power board | 240 x 180 mm (230 x 170) | 4 x 70 um (2 x 70 um only if the layout agent proves gate/Kelvin adjacency and the loop target in two layers) | 2.0 mm | 0.25 mm track/space preferred, 0.20 mm minimum; 0.3 mm drill; 1.0 mm non-plated slots |
| Control board | 120 x 80 mm | 4 x 35 um | 1.6 mm | 0.15 mm; 0.3 mm drill |

Power-board stack-up (symmetric, KR-PCB-001, KR-PCB-006, SKILL-002 principles 1-2):

| Layer | Copper | Content |
|---|---|---|
| L1 (top) | 70 um | HF ceramics, Vin+ / SW / Vout+ pours, device pads, film pads, HV terminals, mezzanine socket |
| prepreg 0.20 mm | | commutation-loop dielectric |
| L2 | 70 um | PGND return pour under the whole commutation loop and bus; GND_CTRL pour under the SELV strip |
| core about 1.1 mm | | |
| L3 | 70 um | Kelvin-source pours in each driver island (shield between the gate layer and everything else); parallel Vin+ / SW / Vout+ pours; 12 V and 3V3 distribution in the SELV strip |
| prepreg 0.20 mm | | gate-loop dielectric |
| L4 (bottom) | 70 um | gate pours with the drivers, DESAT, rail decoupling and bias modules directly under the device row (TIDA-010054 decision 10); parallel PGND / Vout pours; SELV-strip parts |

Control-board stack-up: L1 components and signals, L2 solid GND_CTRL, L3 power islands (1V9, 3V3, 5V, 12V_PROT), L4 signals, JTAG, mezzanine header; one ground net, no splits under ADC or PWM tracks (V1 practice). Net classes follow the standards agent (HV_VIN, HV_SW, HV_PGND, HV_VOUT, DRV_HS, DRV_LS, DESAT_HS, DESAT_LS, PE, CTRL_SELV); the control board carries CTRL_SELV only.

## 8 Partition

Power board, HV area: 2 x C4MS025120K on the shared heat sink with rated insulating pads; 10 x CGA9P1X7T2J474M; 2 x B32776G8206K; 2 x B32776G4606K; L1 toroid in its potting cup on four M4 standoffs; input bleeder chain (3 x CRCW2512120K) with DC-LINK LIVE LED, output bleeders (2 x CRCW2512100K), optional MOV S20K385; RC snubber pads; PTC B59773C0120A070 with the relay-contact terminals; HV terminals Vin+, PGND_in, Vout+, PGND_out; PE stud M4. Driver islands (bottom side): 2 x UCC21710-Q1 with gate resistors, DESAT diodes, Miller clamp link, gate discharge resistors (KR-GD-007), rail decoupling, TLV76050 5V_ISO LDO on the low-side island, NTC connector, MMCX V_GS jacks. Barrier line (slots under every body with a land gap < 9 mm, KR-ISO-004): 2 x UCC14141-Q1, 2 x UCC21710-Q1, 2 x AMC1311B with their HV ladders, TMCS1133C2AQDVGR in the output path. SELV strip (30 mm): mezzanine socket, driver-input RC filters and pull-downs, bias-module input CM chokes and capacitors (KR-IS-002, SKILL-004), protected 12 V distribution, 3V3_PWRBOARD, relay-coil switch AO3400A with flyback diode and coil terminals, test points, four M3 standoff holes.

Control board: 12 V entry connector, SMBJ15CA, TPS26400 eFuse (CB-PR-001 / KR-PR-003), TPS54302, TPS767D301, TPS3808; TMS320F28335PGFA with oscillator, decoupling, ADC reference parts, boot straps, 14-pin JTAG and UART header; SN74LVC2G08, SN74LVC1G74, 2 x SN74LV21A; 2 x TLV1702 and REF3125; OPA2320 front ends and ADC RC filters; LM61; LEDs; E-stop header; mezzanine header.

Off-board: KLKD020.T fuse in a 10 x 38 mm holder on the input lead, Omron G9EA-1 DC12 bypass relay (73 x 36 x 67.2 mm, screw terminals, chassis-mounted), external 12 V supply and 80 mm fan.

## 9 Interconnect

The controller agent's 50-pin assignment is adopted unchanged (3 x 12V_PROT, 25 x GND_CTRL, PWM_H / PWM_L ground-guarded, fault and ready lines, TEMP_PWM, analogue group at the far end). The socket (Samtec SSW-125-01-G-D or Wurth WR-PHD) sits on the power-board SELV strip so that live SELV pins are never exposed and a bench fixture can plug in; the header (TSW-125-07-G-D) sits on the control board, mirroring the TI controlCARD / baseboard practice (TMDSCNCD28335 is a DIMM100 card that requires a baseboard). The 12 V pins carry 0.26 A each at the controller agent's 0.77 A budget and 0.38 A if the G9EA-1 coil (417 mA) is kept, against 3 A (WR-PHD, datasheet) or 4.7 A (SSW, distributor data). Mated stack height is designed at 11 mm and must be confirmed from the Samtec drawings.

## 10 Mechanical assembly concept

Both boards mount on a PE-bonded aluminium baseplate (open frame, A-24). The power board sits on six M4 x 15 mm standoffs; bottom-side parts are limited to 10 mm. The heat sink (reservation 100 x 40 x 50 mm, fins along x, about 900 cm2 fin area) stands in the middle of the board over the device row; both TO-247-4 stand vertically against its face with leads straight into the board; the drivers are underneath. The device row borders the barrier; the SELV strip is the bottom edge of the board. The control board (120 x 80 mm) stacks 11 mm above the SELV strip and the barrier zone and overhangs the board edge by 40 mm; all four of its M3 standoffs go to the baseplate (two through clearance holes in the strip), so nothing is cantilevered. Control-board copper never lies above HV copper: the worst-case air gap from the barrier's HV edge to control-board copper is sqrt(5^2 + 11^2) = 12.1 mm >= 9.0 mm. The inductor sits beyond the fins in a parallel air path, >= 10 mm from the sink; the films sit beside the sink, not in its exhaust; the 80 mm fan blows along the fins from the input-terminal end, and the exhaust end carries only terminals, bleeders and the PE stud. Estimated mass 1.65 kg plus hardware.

## 11 Target metrics to check after layout

| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| Power-board area | <= 43,200 mm2 (stretch 37,400) |
| Control-board area | <= 9,600 mm2 |
| Total PCB area / plan bounding box | <= 52,800 mm2, -20 % versus V1 / <= 240 x 220 mm |
| Height above baseplate | <= 67 mm (limit 80) |
| Commutation loop | <= 20-25 nH including packages (PE-PCB-003) |
| Driver-to-device distance | <= 15 mm (KR-PCB-005) |
| Gate / Kelvin pour overlap on L4 / L3 | >= 80 % of the gate pour area (KR-PCB-001) |
| Barrier | 9.0 mm DRC clean on all four layers, slots under seven isolators (KR-ISO-001/004) |
| Single-ended PWM segment | <= 100 mm (KR-GD-008 exclusion) |
| HV copper to heat sink | >= 5.0 mm (KR-TH-002) |
| 12 V mezzanine pins | <= 0.4 A per pin |

## 12 Verification status

Analytically checked: zone sums, control-board sizing, outlines, heights and volumes, cost index, weighted scores with three sensitivity sets, barrier air gap, fine-pitch etch budget, barrier heat conduction, heat-sink sanity (T_J 105-139 degC for 0.5-1.1 K/W), connector current.
Unverified: TO-247-4 package drawing (Wolfspeed PDF not text-readable; 16.1 x 23.6 x 5.2 mm from distributor data), Samtec insulator and mated stack height, Wurth 50-pin socket orderability, heat-sink profile and forced-air resistance (CR201 natural 3.3 K/W at 50 mm, forced-air chart not readable), control-board utilisation, 70 um density assumption, cost factors, mass estimates, standoff hardware.
Human review: the 9.0 mm all-layer barrier and the air-gap argument for the stacked control board (KR-ISO-002), 2- versus 4-layer power board, heat-sink height versus A-24, relay-coil current versus the 12 V budget, exhaust placement (SKILL-006 step 3), HV terminal type and off-board harness, scoring weights.
